items.title: URGENT - PHP Warns of Another Unpatched RCE Two Days After Emergency PHP2Shell Patches
items.snippet: PHP has warned of another way an attacker could run code on a web server, two days after it shipped emergency fixes for the critical PHP2Shell flaws. The new issue, assigned CVE-2026-115560, affects only web applications configured in an unusual way, and PHP considers it an unlikely risk. The project is not issuing an
items.summary: PHP warns of another potential remote code execution issue after emergency PHP2Shell fixes. It says the new issue affects web applications configured in an unusual way.
items.why: Review PHP web application configurations and check for available fixes.

According to ESET, the attack involved UAC-0099 (aka Earth Sirrush) obtaining initial access to the target on July 16, 2025, via a spear-phis

items.title: China APT Uses AI Pentest Tool Artex in ConnectWise Attacks
items.snippet: The state-sponsored hackers targeted hundreds of organizations and gained privileged access to some environments. The post China APT Uses AI Pentest Tool Artex in ConnectWise Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Critical Flaw in Python’s Popular Pillow Image Library Allows Code Execution via a Crafted Image
items.snippet: Pillow, the most widely used image library for Python, can be made to run operating system commands on a server by specifying the name of a file it is told to open. The flaw, CVE-2026-112900, is in the way Pillow handles EPS images, which it opens by passing the file's name to Ghostscript, a separate program it runs to
items.summary: A flaw in Pillow’s handling of EPS images can allow operating system commands to run on a server when it opens a specified file.
items.why: Check servers that use Pillow to open EPS images and review file-handling safeguards.

items.title: Attackers Exploit Third VeloCloud Orchestrator Zero-Day in Four Months
items.snippet: The critical-severity SQL injection flaw allows attackers to access privileged internal functionality and gain operator privileges. The post Attackers Exploit Third VeloCloud Orchestrator Zero-Day in Four Months appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.summary: The critical SQL injection flaw in VeloCloud Orchestrator allows attackers to access privileged internal functionality and gain operator privileges.
items.why: Check VeloCloud Orchestrator for exposure and apply available security fixes.

items.title: Researchers Demonstrate Node2Shell RCE Exploit on Node.js Build Using Crafted Brotli Data
items.snippet: Malicious Brotli data can make an application on an official build of Node.js run attacker-supplied code, security researchers at Imperva have demonstrated. Their "Node2Shell" proof of concept ran code on the official Node.js 24.22.0 image for Linux arm64, with no debugger or custom build, by feeding crafted data to th
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated that malicious Brotli data can make an application on an official Node.js build run attacker-supplied code.
items.why: Check how applications process Brotli data and monitor for unexpected code execution.

items.title: Critical x402 SDK Flaw Could Let Malicious APIs Drain AI Agents’ Token Balances
items.snippet: AI agents paying for API calls with the x402 SDKs could sign a payment for their full balance of a supported token if a malicious API asked for it, security firm V12 said on October 22. The cause was the SDKs' default client, which set no spending limit until releases on August 18 added one. The risk was limited to age
items.summary: Security firm V12 says a malicious API could ask x402 SDK clients to sign payments for their full balance of a supported token.
items.why: Check x402 SDK payment limits before allowing AI agents to pay APIs.

items.title: Quest Diagnostics Reports Cyber Breach Affecting ‘Certain Patient Records’
items.snippet: In a regulatory filing, Quest Diagnostics reported unauthorized access to its Quanum Lab Services Manager, a platform where certain clients can place test orders. The post Quest Diagnostics Reports Cyber Breach Affecting ‘Certain Patient Records’ appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.summary: Quest Diagnostics reported unauthorized access to Quanum Lab Services Manager, where certain clients can place test orders.
items.why: Check access to lab-service platforms and review records for unauthorized activity.
